sources.title: GitHub - AyushmaanDecoded/Visual-Product-Matcher: The Visual Product ...
sources.snippet: The Visual Product Matcher is a web app using OpenAI's CLIP model to find similar products based on an uploaded image. Built with the MERN stack, it processes the image in the backend to match visual features with product descriptions. The React frontend displays the image and similar product results, enabling seamless product discovery.
